capability.scope: same frozen monitoring mixture as previous run; repeats disclosed; not a new general ability benchmark

preregistration.generation: greedy,batch8,max160 new tokens,no thinking; full independent outputs, no answer pool

preregistration.judge_limit: same-model rater and authored calibration, not independent human validation
preregistration.matched_axis: NOT_RUN: spoken conditions failed behavior calibration, so no new mean-difference axis is extracted
preregistration.material_selection: discovery only: maximize balanced style agreement among written>=.8 and content>=.8; chosen user-request v3

preregistration.qualified: unedited output written, edited output colloquial under both evaluators, edited content correct, not truncated
preregistration.question: Can the preexisting weight edit induce qualified colloquial free completions from stable written-source long prompts?
